label: Demonstration data · fictional league · not current player advice
limitations: Real player names identify illustrative roster slots only. All prices, projected statistics, rosters and transactions are hypothetical; they are not actual player assessments.
Frozen Week 5 example; supported changes are not promised results.
No injury probabilities, playoff odds or multi-season forecast are inferred.
Reserve points summarize useful disjoint legal replacements, not a second complete starting lineup.

team.name: Harbor Front Office
team.strength: Three projected quarterbacks provide meaningful Superflex replacement cover.
team.limitation: Using a reserve quarterback to improve receivers can remove that quarterback cover. Current points do not establish future availability.
team.next_step: Compare a receiver upgrade with its quarterback-depth cost before pursuing it.

active.name: Harbor Front Office
active.benefit: The incoming receiver improves the best legal starting lineup.
active.cost: Sending a starting quarterback uses the third quarterback as the Superflex starter; there is no further quarterback replacement in this example.

partner.name: Summit Front Office
partner.benefit: The incoming quarterback improves the best legal starting lineup.
partner.cost: Summit gives up its highest-projected receiver and relies on its other receivers to cover WR and FLEX.

trade.qualification: An evaluated hypothetical offer, not a prediction that another manager accepts. Both rosters are evaluated using the same neutral evidence.
